correctness.rationale: In Q_7, the 2-frameproof constraint is exactly no third distinct vertex on any pairwise Hamming geodesic. The inspected normalized lexicographic DFS excludes precisely all bad third vertices for each selected pair; induction on increasing extensions makes the enumeration exhaustive, not heuristic. Independent full origin-normalized enumeration found 7,560 size-nine codes and zero size-ten codes (2,986,961 and 2,029,645 explored recursion nodes respectively). Since nine is odd, no nonzero cube translation stabilizes a maximum, so labeled count =7560*128/9=107,520. Independently constructed coordinate-permutation and translation orbit action yielding exactly two classes sized 80,640 and 26,880, stabilizers 8 and 24; source pair-distance profiles distinguish them.
